# ARM: gate ON = SCRIP_RTX_ALLOC default (asm rt_ws_alloc fast path live) vs OFF = SCRIP_RTX_ALLOC=0 (pure C c_rt_ws_alloc, byte-identical to pre-rung code).

# tree: FINDING-2026-08-28-seat03-rtx-startup-touch-target-list-and-rt-ws-alloc.md carries the full derivation, the target list, and why this null is expected (gate toggles CODE PATH, not what's MAPPED).
# READING: no delta outside run-to-run noise (+/-2 minflt, +/-150KB maxrss) on either workload or arm --
# expected and structural, not a null instrument: the gate is a runtime byte test, both the 157B asm
# entry and the 532B C fallback are linked into the SAME .so and resident regardless of its value, so
# flipping it moves per-call TIME (fewer instructions on the fast arm), never MAPPED FOOTPRINT. The
# floor (hq_P's 430-fault library-load cost) is paid by relocation + ELF constructors before the gate
# is ever read. Structural fact instead (nm -S, unaffected by run noise): rt_ws_alloc(asm)=157B vs
# c_rt_ws_alloc(C,unchanged)=532B -- 3.4x smaller per call, but net +157B .text THIS rung since the C
# body stays linked; the floor only shrinks once the twin is deleted (deferred, see FINDING NEXT).
